summary: Blocked: this commit fixes test input handling, not the algorithm implementation. The previous QuickCheck test passed disconnected graphs to an algorithm requiring connected terminals, potentially panicking on unreachable shortest-path targets. The replacement steiner_tree_spans_terminals test in tests/quickcheck.rs processes connected components separately and skips components with fewer than two nodes. Changes to src/algo/steiner_tree.rs affect documentation only; all implementation code is identical to the parent. No implementation reversal can reproduce this correction while preserving upstream tests.
